The sNDA was submitted by Mundipharma, CorMedix’s global development partner, and the FDA has granted Priority Review with a Prescription Drug User Fee Act (PDUFA) target action date in Q1 2027.
The sNDA is supported by the Phase III ReSPECT pivotal study, for which CorMedix announced positive topline results in April.
